parameters.content:
## 19 · Comment Replier
New comment on your Instagram or Facebook post → AI writes a short reply in your brand voice and posts it. **Complaints, spam, refund or angry comments are never answered by AI**: the owner gets a WhatsApp alert instead. Every comment is logged.

**Setup (25 min)**
1. Meta developer app → Webhooks: callback URL = this workflow's webhook URL, verify token = YOUR_VERIFY_TOKEN. Subscribe to Instagram **comments** and/or Page **feed**.
2. Replace YOUR_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token with instagram_manage_comments / pages_manage_engagement), YOUR_IG_ACCOUNT_ID and YOUR_PAGE_ID.
3. Edit the BRAND FACTS line in **AI writes reply**.
4. WhatsApp nodes: add a **WhatsApp Business Cloud API** credential and replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID with your Phone Number ID (Meta → WhatsApp → API setup). Replace YOUR_OWNER_WHATSAPP with the owner's WhatsApp number in 91XXXXXXXXXX format.
5. Google Sheets nodes: add a **Google Sheets OAuth2** credential and paste your sheet link in place of YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_URL. Tab **Comments**: Time, Platform, From, Comment, Type, Reply.
6. AI model node: add an **Anthropic** credential (or swap the model node for OpenAI / Gemini).

Activate the workflow so Meta can reach the webhook.

parameters.text:
=Someone commented on a {{ $json.platform }} post of YOUR BUSINESS NAME.
Commenter: {{ $json.from }}
Comment: "{{ $json.text }}"

BRAND FACTS (use only these): EDIT THIS: what you sell, city, timings, how to order (e.g. 'DM us or WhatsApp us, link in bio').

type: question | praise | complaint | spam | other. reply: a short public reply in the brand voice (max 2 lines, 1 emoji max, friendly). For price or order questions say 'please check your DM / WhatsApp us' unless the price is in the brand facts. Public replies never discuss refunds, order problems or personal details.
RULES (never break these): You are an assistant for YOUR BUSINESS NAME, a small Indian business, not the owner. Never offer or hint at discounts, refunds, free items or compensation. Never promise delivery dates, results or guarantees that are not given in this prompt. Never invent prices, stock, policies or facts: use ONLY the data given in this prompt. Greet with 'Hello <name> ji' (never 'Namaste'). Reply in the customer's language (English, Hindi or Hinglish in Roman script). Set handoff=true when the customer is angry or upset, asks for a refund, discount or compensation, mentions legal action, or asks anything you are not sure of. When handoff=true the reply must only say the owner will personally call back soon.
